title: select_monitor
description: Vision v2: which screen to stream. Sent on the Vision channel, only for the admin holding a session for the device. The viewer also sends its current selection again when it needs a full frame (regions were dropped on the way), so the agent answers every select_monitor with a full frame of the selection.

index.description: A screen `index` from `monitors`, or `all`: every screen side by side in one image (monitor byte 0xFF).
